NKJV.1: Then  the children of Israel, the whole congregation, came into the Wilderness of Zin in the first month, and the people stayed in Kadesh; and Miriam died there and was buried there.
NKJV.2: Now there was no water for the congregation; so they gathered together against Moses and Aaron.
NKJV.3: And the people contended with Moses and spoke, saying: “If only we had died when our brethren died before the LORD!
NKJV.4: Why have you brought up the assembly of the LORD into this wilderness, that we and our animals should die here?
NKJV.5: And why have you made us come up out of Egypt, to bring us to this evil place? It is not a place of grain or figs or vines or pomegranates; nor is there any water to drink.”
NKJV.6: So Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly to the door of the tabernacle of meeting, and they fell on their faces. And the glory of the LORD appeared to them.
NKJV.7: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
NKJV.8: “Take the rod; you and your brother Aaron gather the congregation together. Speak to the rock before their eyes, and it will yield its water; thus you shall bring water for them out of the rock, and give drink to the congregation and their animals.”
NKJV.9: So Moses took the rod from before the LORD as He commanded him.
NKJV.10: And Moses and Aaron gathered the assembly together before the rock; and he said to them, “Hear now, you rebels! Must we bring water for you out of this rock?”
NKJV.11: Then Moses lifted his hand and struck the rock twice with his rod; and water came out abundantly, and the congregation and their animals drank.
NKJV.12: Then the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron, “Because you did not believe Me, to hallow Me in the eyes of the children of Israel, therefore you shall not bring this assembly into the land which I have given them.”
NKJV.13: This was the water of Meribah, because the children of Israel contended with the LORD, and He was hallowed among them.
NKJV.14: Now Moses sent messengers from Kadesh to the king of Edom. “Thus says your brother Israel: ‘You know all the hardship that has befallen us,
NKJV.15: how our fathers went down to Egypt, and we dwelt in Egypt a long time, and the Egyptians afflicted us and our fathers.
NKJV.16: When we cried out to the LORD, He heard our voice and sent the Angel and brought us up out of Egypt; now here we are in Kadesh, a city on the edge of your border.
NKJV.17: Please let us pass through your country. We will not pass through fields or vineyards, nor will we drink water from wells; we will go along the King’s Highway; we will not turn aside to the right hand or to the left until we have passed through your territory.’ ”
NKJV.18: Then Edom said to him, “You shall not pass through my land, lest I come out against you with the sword.”
NKJV.19: So the children of Israel said to him, “We will go by the Highway, and if I or my livestock drink any of your water, then I will pay for it; let me only pass through on foot, nothing more.”
NKJV.20: Then he said, “You shall not pass through.” So Edom came out against them with many men and with a strong hand.
NKJV.21: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his territory; so Israel turned away from him.
NKJV.22: Now the children of Israel, the whole congregation, journeyed from Kadesh and came to Mount Hor.
NKJV.23: And the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron in Mount Hor by the border of the land of Edom, saying:
NKJV.24: “Aaron shall be gathered to his people, for he shall not enter the land which I have given to the children of Israel, because you rebelled against My word at the water of Meribah.
NKJV.25: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and bring them up to Mount Hor;
NKJV.26: and strip Aaron of his garments and put them on Eleazar his son; for Aaron shall be gathered to his people and die there.”
NKJV.27: So Moses did just as the LORD commanded, and they went up to Mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.
NKJV.28: Moses stripped Aaron of his garments and put them on Eleazar his son; and Aaron died there on the top of the mountain. Then Moses and Eleazar came down from the mountain.
NKJV.29: Now when all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead, all the house of Israel mourned for Aaron thirty days.

ESV.1: And the people of Israel, the whole congregation, came into the wilderness of Zin in the first month, and the people stayed in Kadesh. And Miriam died there and was buried there.
ESV.2: Now there was no water for the congregation. And they assembled themselves together against Moses and against Aaron.
ESV.3: And the people quarreled with Moses and said, “Would that we had perished when our brothers perished before the LORD!
ESV.4: Why have you brought the assembly of the LORD into this wilderness, that we should die here, both we and our cattle?
ESV.5: And why have you made us come up out of Egypt to bring us to this evil place? It is no place for grain or figs or vines or pomegranates, and there is no water to drink.”
ESV.6: Then Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly to the entrance of the tent of meeting and fell on their faces. And the glory of the LORD appeared to them,
ESV.7: and the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
ESV.8: “Take the staff, and assemble the congregation, you and Aaron your brother, and tell the rock before their eyes to yield its water. So you shall bring water out of the rock for them and give drink to the congregation and their cattle.”
ESV.9: And Moses took the staff from before the LORD, as he commanded him.
ESV.10: Then Moses and Aaron gathered the assembly together before the rock, and he said to them, “Hear now, you rebels: shall we bring water for you out of this rock?”
ESV.11: And Moses lifted up his hand and struck the rock with his staff twice, and water came out abundantly, and the congregation drank, and their livestock.
ESV.12: And the LORD said to Moses and Aaron, “Because you did not believe in me, to uphold me as holy in the eyes of the people of Israel, therefore you shall not bring this assembly into the land that I have given them.”
ESV.13: These are the waters of Meribah,  where the people of Israel quarreled with the LORD, and through them he showed himself holy.
ESV.14: Moses sent messengers from Kadesh to the king of Edom: “Thus says your brother Israel: You know all the hardship that we have met:
ESV.15: how our fathers went down to Egypt, and we lived in Egypt a long time. And the Egyptians dealt harshly with us and our fathers.
ESV.16: And when we cried to the LORD, he heard our voice and sent an angel and brought us out of Egypt. And here we are in Kadesh, a city on the edge of your territory.
ESV.17: Please let us pass through your land. We will not pass through field or vineyard, or drink water from a well. We will go along the King's Highway. We will not turn aside to the right hand or to the left until we have passed through your territory.”
ESV.18: But Edom said to him, “You shall not pass through, lest I come out with the sword against you.”
ESV.19: And the people of Israel said to him, “We will go up by the highway, and if we drink of your water, I and my livestock, then I will pay for it. Let me only pass through on foot, nothing more.”
ESV.20: But he said, “You shall not pass through.” And Edom came out against them with a large army and with a strong force.
ESV.21: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his territory, so Israel turned away from him.
ESV.22: And they journeyed from Kadesh, and the people of Israel, the whole congregation, came to Mount Hor.
ESV.23: And the LORD said to Moses and Aaron at Mount Hor, on the border of the land of Edom,
ESV.24: “Let Aaron be gathered to his people, for he shall not enter the land that I have given to the people of Israel, because you rebelled against my command at the waters of Meribah.
ESV.25: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son and bring them up to Mount Hor.
ESV.26: And strip Aaron of his garments and put them on Eleazar his son. And Aaron shall be gathered to his people and shall die there.”
ESV.27: Moses did as the LORD commanded. And they went up Mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.
ESV.28: And Moses stripped Aaron of his garments and put them on Eleazar his son. And Aaron died there on the top of the mountain. Then Moses and Eleazar came down from the mountain.
ESV.29: And when all the congregation saw that Aaron had perished, all the house of Israel wept for Aaron thirty days.

NASB.1: Then the sons of Israel, the whole congregation, came to the wilderness of Zin in the first month; and the people stayed at Kadesh. Now Miriam died there and was buried there.
NASB.2: There was no water for the congregation, and they assembled themselves against Moses and Aaron.
NASB.3: The people thus contended with Moses and spoke, saying, 'If only we had perished when our brothers perished before the LORD!
NASB.4: 'Why then have you brought the LORD'S assembly into this wilderness, for us and our beasts to die here?
NASB.5: 'Why have you made us come up from Egypt, to bring us in to this wretched place? It is not a place of grain or figs or vines or pomegranates, nor is there water to drink.'
NASB.6: Then Moses and Aaron came in from the presence of the assembly to the doorway of the tent of meeting and fell on their faces. Then the glory of the LORD appeared to them;
NASB.7: and the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
NASB.8: 'Take the rod; and you and your brother Aaron assemble the congregation and speak to the rock before their eyes, that it may yield its water. You shall thus bring forth water for them out of the rock and let the congregation and their beasts drink.'
NASB.9: So Moses took the rod from before the LORD, just as He had commanded him;
NASB.10: and Moses and Aaron gathered the assembly before the rock. And he said to them, 'Listen now, you rebels; shall we bring forth water for you out of this rock?'
NASB.11: Then Moses lifted up his hand and struck the rock twice with his rod; and water came forth abundantly, and the congregation and their beasts drank.
NASB.12: But the LORD said to Moses and Aaron, 'Because you have not believed Me, to treat Me as holy in the sight of the sons of Israel, therefore you shall not bring this assembly into the land which I have given them.'
NASB.13: Those [were] the waters of Meribah, because the sons of Israel contended with the LORD, and He proved Himself holy among them.
NASB.14: From Kadesh Moses then sent messengers to the king of Edom: 'Thus your brother Israel has said, 'You know all the hardship that has befallen us;
NASB.15: that our fathers went down to Egypt, and we stayed in Egypt a long time, and the Egyptians treated us and our fathers badly.
NASB.16: 'But when we cried out to the LORD, He heard our voice and sent an angel and brought us out from Egypt; now behold, we are at Kadesh, a town on the edge of your territory.
NASB.17: 'Please let us pass through your land. We will not pass through field or through vineyard; we will not even drink water from a well. We will go along the king's highway, not turning to the right or left, until we pass through your territory.''
NASB.18: Edom, however, said to him, 'You shall not pass through us, or I will come out with the sword against you.'
NASB.19: Again, the sons of Israel said to him, 'We will go up by the highway, and if I and my livestock do drink any of your water, then I will pay its price. Let me only pass through on my feet, nothing [else].'
NASB.20: But he said, 'You shall not pass through.' And Edom came out against him with a heavy force and with a strong hand.
NASB.21: Thus Edom refused to allow Israel to pass through his territory; so Israel turned away from him.
NASB.22: Now when they set out from Kadesh, the sons of Israel, the whole congregation, came to Mount Hor.
NASB.23: Then the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron at Mount Hor by the border of the land of Edom, saying,
NASB.24: 'Aaron will be gathered to his people; for he shall not enter the land which I have given to the sons of Israel, because you rebelled against My command at the waters of Meribah.
NASB.25: 'Take Aaron and his son Eleazar and bring them up to Mount Hor;
NASB.26: and strip Aaron of his garments and put them on his son Eleazar. So Aaron will be gathered [to his people], and will die there.'
NASB.27: So Moses did just as the LORD had commanded, and they went up to Mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.
NASB.28: After Moses had stripped Aaron of his garments and put them on his son Eleazar, Aaron died there on the mountain top. Then Moses and Eleazar came down from the mountain.
NASB.29: When all the congregation saw that Aaron had died, all the house of Israel wept for Aaron thirty days.

WEB.1: The children of Israel, even the whole congregation, came into the wilderness of Zin in the first month. The people stayed in Kadesh. Miriam died there, and was buried there.
WEB.2: There was no water for the congregation; and they assembled themselves together against Moses and against Aaron.
WEB.3: The people quarreled with Moses, and spoke, saying, “We wish that we had died when our brothers died before Yahweh!
WEB.4: Why have you brought Yahweh’s assembly into this wilderness, that we should die there, we and our animals?
WEB.5: Why have you made us to come up out of Egypt, to bring us in to this evil place? It is no place of seed, or of figs, or of vines, or of pomegranates; neither is there any water to drink.”
WEB.6: Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and fell on their faces. Yahweh’s glory appeared to them.
WEB.8: “Take the rod, and assemble the congregation, you, and Aaron your brother, and speak to the rock before their eyes, that it pour out its water. You shall bring water to them out of the rock; so you shall give the congregation and their livestock drink.”
WEB.9: Moses took the rod from before Yahweh, as he commanded him.
WEB.10: Moses and Aaron gathered the assembly together before the rock, and he said to them, “Hear now, you rebels! Shall we bring water out of this rock for you?”
WEB.11: Moses lifted up his hand, and struck the rock with his rod twice, and water came out abundantly. The congregation and their livestock drank.
WEB.12: Yahweh said to Moses and Aaron, “Because you didn’t believe in me, to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of Israel, therefore you shall not bring this assembly into the land which I have given them.”
WEB.13: These are the waters of Meribah; because the children of Israel strove with Yahweh, and he was sanctified in them.
WEB.14: Moses sent messengers from Kadesh to the king of Edom, saying: “Thus says your brother Israel: You know all the travail that has happened to us;
WEB.15: how our fathers went down into Egypt, and we lived in Egypt a long time. The Egyptians mistreated us and our fathers.
WEB.16: When we cried to Yahweh, he heard our voice, sent an angel, and brought us out of Egypt. Behold, we are in Kadesh, a city in the edge of your border.
WEB.17: “Please let us pass through your land. We will not pass through field or through vineyard, neither will we drink from the water of the wells. We will go along the king’s highway. We will not turn aside to the right hand nor to the left, until we have passed your border.”
WEB.18: Edom said to him, “You shall not pass through me, lest I come out with the sword against you.”
WEB.19: The children of Israel said to him, “We will go up by the highway; and if we drink your water, I and my livestock, then I will give its price. Only let me, without doing anything else, pass through on my feet.”
WEB.20: He said, “You shall not pass through.” Edom came out against him with many people, and with a strong hand.
WEB.21: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his border, so Israel turned away from him.
WEB.22: They traveled from Kadesh: and the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, came to Mount Hor.
WEB.23: Yahweh spoke to Moses and Aaron in Mount Hor, by the border of the land of Edom, saying,
WEB.24: “Aaron shall be gathered to his people; for he shall not enter into the land which I have given to the children of Israel, because you rebelled against my word at the waters of Meribah.
WEB.25: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and bring them up to Mount Hor;
WEB.26: and strip Aaron of his garments, and put them on Eleazar his son. Aaron shall be taken, and shall die there.”
WEB.27: Moses did as Yahweh commanded. They went up into Mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.
WEB.28: Moses stripped Aaron of his garments, and put them on Eleazar his son. Aaron died there on the top of the mountain, and Moses and Eleazar came down from the mountain.
WEB.29: When all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead, they wept for Aaron thirty days, even all the house of Israel.

NLT.1: In the first month of the year, the whole community of Israel arrived in the wilderness of Zin and camped at Kadesh. While they were there, Miriam died and was buried.
NLT.2: There was no water for the people to drink at that place, so they rebelled against Moses and Aaron.
NLT.3: The people blamed Moses and said, “If only we had died in the LORD’s presence with our brothers!
NLT.4: Why have you brought the congregation of the LORD’s people into this wilderness to die, along with all our livestock?
NLT.5: Why did you make us leave Egypt and bring us here to this terrible place? This land has no grain, no figs, no grapes, no pomegranates, and no water to drink!”
NLT.6: Moses and Aaron turned away from the people and went to the entrance of the Tabernacle, where they fell face down on the ground. Then the glorious presence of the LORD appeared to them,
NLT.7: and the LORD said to Moses,
NLT.8: “You and Aaron must take the staff and assemble the entire community. As the people watch, speak to the rock over there, and it will pour out its water. You will provide enough water from the rock to satisfy the whole community and their livestock.”
NLT.9: So Moses did as he was told. He took the staff from the place where it was kept before the LORD.
NLT.10: Then he and Aaron summoned the people to come and gather at the rock. “Listen, you rebels!” he shouted. “Must we bring you water from this rock?”
NLT.11: Then Moses raised his hand and struck the rock twice with the staff, and water gushed out. So the entire community and their livestock drank their fill.
NLT.12: But the LORD said to Moses and Aaron, “Because you did not trust me enough to demonstrate my holiness to the people of Israel, you will not lead them into the land I am giving them!”
NLT.13: This place was known as the waters of Meribah (which means “arguing”) because there the people of Israel argued with the LORD, and there he demonstrated his holiness among them.
NLT.14: While Moses was at Kadesh, he sent ambassadors to the king of Edom with this message: “This is what your relatives, the people of Israel, say: You know all the hardships we have been through.
NLT.15: Our ancestors went down to Egypt, and we lived there a long time, and we and our ancestors were brutally mistreated by the Egyptians.
NLT.16: But when we cried out to the LORD, he heard us and sent an angel who brought us out of Egypt. Now we are camped at Kadesh, a town on the border of your land.
NLT.17: Please let us travel through your land. We will be careful not to go through your fields and vineyards. We won’t even drink water from your wells. We will stay on the king’s road and never leave it until we have passed through your territory.”
NLT.18: But the king of Edom said, “Stay out of my land, or I will meet you with an army!”
NLT.19: The Israelites answered, “We will stay on the main road. If our livestock drink your water, we will pay for it. Just let us pass through your country. That’s all we ask.”
NLT.20: But the king of Edom replied, “Stay out! You may not pass through our land.” With that he mobilized his army and marched out against them with an imposing force.
NLT.21: Because Edom refused to allow Israel to pass through their country, Israel was forced to turn around.
NLT.22: The whole community of Israel left Kadesh and arrived at Mount Hor.
NLT.23: There, on the border of the land of Edom, the LORD said to Moses and Aaron,
NLT.24: “The time has come for Aaron to join his ancestors in death. He will not enter the land I am giving the people of Israel, because the two of you rebelled against my instructions concerning the water at Meribah.
NLT.25: Now take Aaron and his son Eleazar up Mount Hor.
NLT.26: There you will remove Aaron’s priestly garments and put them on Eleazar, his son. Aaron will die there and join his ancestors.”
NLT.27: So Moses did as the LORD commanded. The three of them went up Mount Hor together as the whole community watched.
NLT.28: At the summit, Moses removed the priestly garments from Aaron and put them on Eleazar, Aaron’s son. Then Aaron died there on top of the mountain, and Moses and Eleazar went back down.
NLT.29: When the people realized that Aaron had died, all Israel mourned for him thirty days.

AMP.1: Then the Israelites, the whole congregation, came into the Wilderness of Zin in the first month [in the fortieth year after leaving Egypt]. And the people lived in Kadesh. Miriam died there and was buried there.
AMP.2: Now there was no water for the congregation, and they gathered together against Moses and Aaron.
AMP.3: The people contended with Moses, and said, "If only we had perished when our brothers perished [in the plague] before the LORD!
AMP.4: Why have you brought up the assembly of the LORD into this wilderness to die here, we and our livestock?
AMP.5: Why have you made us come up from Egypt, to bring us to this wretched place? It is not a place of grain or of figs or of vines or of pomegranates, and there is no water to drink."
AMP.6: Then Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly to the doorway of the Tent of Meeting (tabernacle) and fell on their faces [before the LORD in prayer]. Then the glory and brilliance of the LORD appeared to them;
AMP.7: and the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
AMP.8: "Take the rod; and you and your brother Aaron assemble the congregation and speak to the rock in front of them, so that it will pour out its water. In this way you shall bring water for them out of the rock and let the congregation and their livestock drink [fresh water]."
AMP.9: So Moses took the rod from before the LORD, just as He had commanded him;
AMP.10: and Moses and Aaron gathered the assembly before the rock. Moses said to them, "Listen now, you rebels; must we bring you water out of this rock?"
AMP.11: Then Moses raised his hand [in anger] and with his rod he struck the rock twice [instead of speaking to the rock as the LORD had commanded]. And the water poured out abundantly, and the congregation and their livestock drank [fresh water].
AMP.12: But the LORD said to Moses and Aaron, "Because you have not believed (trusted) Me, to treat Me as holy in the sight of the sons of Israel, you therefore shall not bring this assembly into the land which I have given them."
AMP.13: These are the waters of Meribah (contention, strife), where the sons of Israel contended with the LORD, and He showed Himself holy among them.
AMP.14: Moses sent messengers from Kadesh to the king of Edom: "Thus says your brother Israel, 'You know all the hardship that has come upon us [as a nation];
AMP.15: that our fathers (ancestors) went down to Egypt, and we lived there for a long time, and the Egyptians treated [both] us and our fathers badly.
AMP.16: But when we cried out to the LORD [for help], He heard us and sent an angel and brought us out of Egypt. Now look, we are in Kadesh, a city on the edge of your territory.
AMP.17: Please let us pass through your land. We will not pass through a field or through a vineyard; we will not even drink water from a well. We will go along the king's highway, not turning [off-course] to the right or to the left until we have passed through your territory.'"
AMP.18: But [the king of] Edom said to him, "You shall not pass through my territory, or I will come out against you with the sword."
AMP.19: Again, the Israelites said to him, "We will go by the highway [trade route], and if I and my livestock drink any of your water, then I will pay for it. Only let me pass through on foot, nothing else."
AMP.20: But the king of Edom said, "You shall not pass through [my territory]." And Edom came out against Israel with many people and a strong hand.
AMP.21: Thus [the king of] Edom refused to give Israel passage through his territory, so Israel turned away from him.
AMP.22: Now when they set out from Kadesh, the Israelites, the whole congregation, came to Mount Hor.
AMP.23: Then the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron at Mount Hor, by the border of the land of Edom, saying,
AMP.24: "Aaron will be gathered to his people [in death]; for he shall not enter the land which I have given to the children of Israel, because you [both] rebelled against My command at the waters of Meribah.
AMP.25: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son and bring them up to Mount Hor;
AMP.26: and strip Aaron of his garments and put them on Eleazar his son. So Aaron will be gathered to his fathers, and will die there."
AMP.27: So Moses did just as the LORD had commanded; and they went up Mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.
AMP.28: After Moses stripped Aaron of his [priestly] garments and put them on Eleazar his son, Aaron died there on the mountain top. Then Moses and Eleazar came down from the mountain.
AMP.29: When all the congregation saw that Aaron had died, all the house of Israel wept (mourned) for him thirty days.
